name: Symbiox Investment & Trading Co Ltd
summary: Symbiox Investment & Trading Co. Ltd. engages in the acquisition, underwriting, holding, and sale of shares, stocks, debentures, debenture stocks, bonds, obligations, and securities. It also engages in the business of textile, fabrics, and trading of sarees. The company was founded on May 14, 1979, and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.
